[Updated at 5:38 PM ET] Apple has also released public release candidates for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

Apple continues to roll out multiple release candidates for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8, now simultaneously releasing RC 5 for both systems, along with developer beta 5 of iOS 26.6, macOS 26.6, iPadOS 26.6, and more. Details below.

macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and Sequoia 15.7.8 RC 5 now available for download

Developers testing macOS Sonoma 14.8.8 and macOS Sequoia 15.7.8 can now install the fifth round of release candidates, as well as macOS 26.6 beta 5 and related versions.

The build numbers for these two release candidates are 23J615 for macOS Sonoma 14.8.8, and 24G817 for macOS Sequoia 15.7.8.

Apple has not disclosed the contents of this update, providing only its standard release notes, which state: "This update contains important security fixes and is recommended for all users."

This update follows iOS, iPadOS, and macOS 26.5.2. The latter had originally included some of the security fixes slated for 26.6, but Apple pushed them out early in response to risks posed by new AI tools. As a result, this update may include some of the fixes that were originally planned for that release.
